tools.name: CreatePresentation
tools.description:
Create a new PowerPoint presentation in OneDrive.

The presentation will be created with a title slide containing the specified title.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: The title for the new presentation.

parameters.name: parent_folder_id
parameters.description: The ID of the folder to create the presentation in. If not provided, the presentation will be created in the root of the user's OneDrive.

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: CreateSlide
tools.description:
Append a new slide to the end of an existing PowerPoint presentation in OneDrive.

The slide will be added at the end of the presentation. Both title and body
are optional to support layouts like BLANK or TITLE_ONLY.

For presentations larger than 4 MB, the upload uses a resumable session.
Concurrency protection (etag check) is best-effort in that case, since
Microsoft Graph upload sessions do not support If-Match headers.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The ID of the PowerPoint presentation to add a slide to.

parameters.name: slide_title
parameters.description: The title for the new slide. Supports markdown: **bold**, *italic*, and __underline__. Optional for layouts like BLANK.

parameters.name: slide_body
parameters.description: The body content for the new slide. Supports markdown: **bold**, *italic*, __underline__, [links](url), `inline code`, # headers, ``` code fences, and bullet points (- item, use spaces for nesting). Optional for layouts like TITLE_ONLY or BLANK.

parameters.name: layout
parameters.description: The layout to use for the slide. For TWO_CONTENT layout, use create_two_content_slide.

output.description: The updated presentation details with new slide info.

tools.name: CreateTwoContentSlide
tools.description:
Append a TWO_CONTENT slide with side-by-side content areas to a PowerPoint presentation.

This layout is useful for comparisons, pros/cons lists, or any content that
benefits from a two-column layout.

For presentations larger than 4 MB, the upload uses a resumable session.
Concurrency protection (etag check) is best-effort in that case, since
Microsoft Graph upload sessions do not support If-Match headers.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The ID of the PowerPoint presentation to add a slide to.

parameters.name: slide_title
parameters.description: The title for the new slide. Supports markdown: **bold**, *italic*, and __underline__.

parameters.name: left_body
parameters.description: Content for the left side of the slide. Supports markdown: **bold**, *italic*, __underline__, [links](url), `inline code`, # headers, ``` code fences, and bullet points (- item, use spaces for nesting).

parameters.name: right_body
parameters.description: Content for the right side of the slide. Supports markdown: **bold**, *italic*, __underline__, [links](url), `inline code`, # headers, ``` code fences, and bullet points (- item, use spaces for nesting).

output.description: The updated presentation details with new slide info.

tools.name: GetAllSlideNotes
tools.description:
Get all speaker notes from every slide in a PowerPoint presentation.

Returns notes for all slides in one call, which is more efficient than
calling get_slide_notes for each slide individually. Notes are returned
in markdown format.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The ID of the PowerPoint presentation.

output.description: All speaker notes from the presentation.

tools.name: GetPresentationAsMarkdown
tools.description:
Get the content of a PowerPoint presentation as markdown.

This tool downloads the presentation and converts it to a markdown representation,
preserving text content, tables, and chart data. Images and other media are
represented as placeholders.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The ID of the PowerPoint presentation to read.

tools.name: GetSlideNotes
tools.description:
Get the speaker notes from a specific slide in a PowerPoint presentation.

Speaker notes are returned in markdown format, preserving basic formatting
like bold, italic, and bullet points.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The ID of the PowerPoint presentation.

parameters.name: slide_index
parameters.description: The 1-based index of the slide to get notes from.

output.description: The speaker notes for the specified slide.

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: SetSlideNotes
tools.description:
Set or update the speaker notes on a specific slide in a PowerPoint presentation.

Notes can be formatted using markdown:
- **bold** for bold text
- *italic* for italic text
- __underline__ for underlined text
- Lines starting with - or * become bullet points

For presentations larger than 4 MB, the upload uses a resumable session.
Concurrency protection (etag check) is best-effort in that case, since
Microsoft Graph upload sessions do not support If-Match headers.
- Indent with spaces for nested bullets

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The ID of the PowerPoint presentation.

parameters.name: slide_index
parameters.description: The 1-based index of the slide to set notes on.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: The speaker notes in markdown format. Supports **bold**, *italic*, __underline__, and bullet points (- or *).

summary:
The Microsoft PowerPoint toolkit lets Arcade agents create and manipulate PowerPoint presentations stored in OneDrive via the Microsoft Graph API.

## Capabilities

- **Presentation creation**: Create new presentations in OneDrive with a title slide, ready for further content.
- **Slide authoring**: Append slides with standard or two-column (TWO_CONTENT) layouts, supporting optional titles and body content for blank, title-only, comparison, or pros/cons formats.
- **Speaker notes management**: Read notes from a single slide or all slides at once, and write/update notes on any slide using Markdown formatting (bold, italic, underline, bullets with nesting).
- **Content extraction**: Download a full presentation and convert it to Markdown, preserving text, tables, and chart data; images and media are represented as placeholders.
- **Large-file handling**: Uploads exceeding 4 MB automatically use resumable Graph upload sessions; concurrency protection via etag is best-effort for these sessions due to Microsoft Graph API limitations.
- **User context**: Retrieve current authenticated user information and their PowerPoint environment.

## OAuth

This toolkit authenticates via OAuth 2.0 using Microsoft as the provider. See the [Arcade Microsoft auth provider docs](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/references/auth-providers/microsoft) for configuration details.
